[package]
name = "cef"
description = "Use cef in Rust"
version = "151.8.0+151.3.24"
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
authors = ["Wu Yu Wei <yuweiwu@pm.me>", "Bill Avery <wravery@gmail.com>", "csmoe <csmoe@msn.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/cef-rs"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["dox"]

[lib]

[[bin]]
name = "bundle-cef-app"

[features]
default = ["sandbox", "build-util", "resources"]
dox = ["cef-dll-sys/dox"]
sandbox = ["cef-dll-sys/sandbox"]
resources = []
accelerated_osr = ["ash", "libc", "objc2-foundation", "objc2-io-surface", "objc2-metal", "thiserror", "tracing", "wgpu", "windows"]
build-util = ["anyhow", "cargo_metadata", "clap", "plist", "semver", "serde", "serde_json", "thiserror"]
linux-x11 = []

[dependencies.cef-dll-sys]
version = "151.8.0"
path = "sys"

[dependencies.ash]
optional = true
version = "0.38"

[dependencies.thiserror]
optional = true
version = "2"

[dependencies.tracing]
optional = true
version = "0.1"

[dependencies.wgpu]
optional = true
version = "30"

[dependencies.anyhow]
optional = true
version = "1"

[dependencies.clap]
optional = true
version = "4"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.cargo_metadata]
optional = true
version = "0.23.1"

[dependencies.serde]
optional = true
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.serde_json]
optional = true
version = "1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows-sys]
version = "0.61"
features = ["Win32_System_Environment", "Win32_System_LibraryLoader", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows]
optional = true
version = "0.62"
features = ["Win32_Graphics_Direct3D12"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
libloading = "0.9"
objc2 = "0.6.3"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
optional = true
version = "0.3.2"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-io-surface]
optional = true
version = "0.3.2"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-metal]
optional = true
version = "0.3"
features = ["objc2-io-surface"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.plist]
optional = true
version = "1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.semver]
optional = true
version = "1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.libc]
optional = true
version = "0.2"

[package]
name = "cef-dll-sys"
description = "cef-rs sys crate"
links = "cef_dll_wrapper"
version = "151.8.0+151.3.24"
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
authors = ["Wu Yu Wei <yuweiwu@pm.me>", "Bill Avery <wravery@gmail.com>", "csmoe <csmoe@msn.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/cef-rs"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["dox"]

[lib]
doctest = false

[features]
dox = []
sandbox = []

[build-dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
cmake = "0.1.52"
serde_json = "1"

[build-dependencies.download-cef]
version = "2.3"
path = "download-cef"

[package]
name = "download-cef"
description = "Download and extract pre-built CEF (Chromium Embedded Framework) archives."
version = "2.3.2"
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
authors = ["Wu Yu Wei <yuweiwu@pm.me>", "Bill Avery <wravery@gmail.com>", "csmoe <csmoe@msn.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/cef-rs"

[dependencies]
regex = "1"
semver = "1"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
bzip2 = "0.6"
indicatif = "0.18"
sha1_smol = "1"
tar = "0.4"
fs-err = "3.2.2"

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.ureq]
version = "3"
features = ["json", "socks-proxy"]

[package]
categories = ["gui"]
description = "Types for handling UI scaling"
edition = "2024"
keywords = ["DPI", "HiDPI", "scale-factor"]
license = "Apache-2.0 AND MIT"
name = "dpi"
repository = "https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit"
rust-version = "1.86"
version = "0.1.2"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["mint", "serde"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]
targets = ["i686-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "aarch64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "i686-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "aarch64-apple-ios", "aarch64-linux-android", "wasm32-unknown-unknown"]

[features]
default = ["std"]
mint = ["dep:mint"]
serde = ["dep:serde"]
std = []

[dependencies.mint]
optional = true
version = "0.5.6"

[dependencies.serde]
optional = true
version = "1"
features = ["serde_derive"]

[package]
name = "tauri"
version = "2.11.5"
description = "Make tiny, secure apps for all desktop platforms with Tauri"
exclude = ["/test", "/.scripts", "CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
links = "Tauri"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
no-default-features = true
features = ["unstable", "custom-protocol", "tray-icon", "devtools", "image-png", "protocol-asset", "test", "specta", "dynamic-acl", "isolation"]
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-linux-android", "x86_64-apple-ios"]

[package.metadata.cargo-udeps.ignore]
normal = ["reqwest"]
build = ["tauri-build"]
development = ["quickcheck_macros"]

[dependencies]
url = "2"
anyhow = "1"
thiserror = "2"
getrandom = "0.3"
serde_repr = "0.1"
http = "1"
dirs = "6"
percent-encoding = "2"
glob = "0.3"
mime = "0.3"
serialize-to-javascript = "0.1.2"
heck = "0.5"
log = "0.4.21"
dunce = "1"
cookie = "0.18"

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
features = ["raw_value"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt", "rt-multi-thread", "sync", "fs", "io-util"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tauri-runtime]
version = "~2.11.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-runtime"

[dependencies.tauri-macros]
version = "~2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-macros"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["resources"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dependencies.raw-window-handle]
version = "0.6"
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.data-url]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.image]
version = "0.25"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.http-range]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.specta]
version = "^2.0.0-rc.25"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["function", "derive", "std"]

[dependencies.bytes]
version = "1"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false
features = ["json", "stream"]

[dependencies.rustls]
version = "0.23"
default-features = false
features = ["ring"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\", target_os = \"windows\", target_os = \"macos\"))".dependencies.muda]
version = "0.19"
default-features = false
features = ["serde", "gtk"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\", target_os = \"windows\", target_os = \"macos\"))".dependencies.tray-icon]
version = "0.24"
default-features = false
features = ["serde", "gtk"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.gtk]
version = "0.18"
features = ["v3_24"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
embed_plist = "1.2"
plist = "1"
window-vibrancy = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSData", "NSThread"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSApplication", "NSColor", "NSResponder", "NSView", "NSWindow", "NSImage"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-web-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["objc2-app-kit", "WKWebView", "WKWebViewConfiguration", "WKUserContentController"]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
window-vibrancy = "0.6"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.61"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_UI", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
jni = "0.21"

[target."cfg(all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"
swift-rs = "1.0.8"

[target."cfg(all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.objc2-ui-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["UIApplication", "UIResponder", "UIView"]

[build-dependencies]
glob = "0.3"
heck = "0.5"

[build-dependencies.tauri-build]
version = "2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-build"
default-features = false

[build-dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["build-2"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dev-dependencies]
proptest = "1.6.0"
quickcheck = "1.0.3"
quickcheck_macros = "1.0.0"
serde_json = "1"
cargo_toml = "1.0"
http-range = "0.1.5"

[dev-dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies.tauri]
path = "."
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["full"]

[features]
default = ["compression", "common-controls-v6", "dynamic-acl"]
unstable = []
common-controls-v6 = ["tray-icon?/common-controls-v6", "muda/common-controls-v6"]
tray-icon = ["dep:tray-icon"]
tracing = ["dep:tracing", "tauri-macros/tracing"]
test = []
compression = ["tauri-macros/compression", "tauri-utils/compression"]
objc-exception = []
linux-libxdo = ["tray-icon/libxdo", "muda/libxdo"]
isolation = ["tauri-utils/isolation", "tauri-macros/isolation", "uuid"]
custom-protocol = ["tauri-macros/custom-protocol"]
native-tls = ["reqwest/native-tls"]
native-tls-vendored = ["reqwest/native-tls-vendored"]
rustls-tls = ["reqwest/rustls-no-provider", "dep:rustls"]
devtools = ["tauri-runtime/devtools"]
process-relaunch-dangerous-allow-symlink-macos = ["tauri-utils/process-relaunch-dangerous-allow-symlink-macos"]
macos-private-api = ["tauri-runtime/macos-private-api"]
webview-data-url = ["data-url", "tauri-utils/html-manipulation-2"]
protocol-asset = ["http-range"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-macros/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-macros/config-toml"]
image-ico = ["image/ico"]
image-png = ["image/png"]
dynamic-acl = []
specta = ["dep:specta"]

[package]
name = "tauri-build"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "build time code to pair with https://crates.io/crates/tauri"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-linux-android", "x86_64-apple-ios"]

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
cargo_toml = "1.0"
serde = "1"
serde_json = "1"
heck = "0.5"
json-patch = "4"
walkdir = "2"
tauri-winres = "0.3"
semver = "1"
dirs = "6"
glob = "0.3"

[dependencies.quote]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.tauri-codegen]
optional = true
version = "~2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-codegen"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["build-2", "resources"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dependencies.schemars]
version = "1"
features = ["preserve_order"]

[features]
default = ["config-json"]
codegen = ["tauri-codegen", "quote"]
isolation = ["tauri-codegen/isolation", "tauri-utils/isolation"]
config-json = []
config-json5 = ["tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-utils/config-toml"]

[package]
name = "tauri-codegen"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "code generation meant to be consumed inside of `tauri` through `tauri-build` or `tauri-macros`"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[dependencies]
sha2 = "0.10"
base64 = "0.22"
proc-macro2 = "1"
quote = "1"
syn = "2"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
walkdir = "2"
semver = "1"
ico = "0.5"
png = "0.18"
json-patch = "4"
url = "2"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
features = ["build-2"]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dependencies.brotli]
version = "8"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
plist = "1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.time]
version = "0.3"
features = ["parsing", "formatting"]

[features]
compression = ["brotli", "tauri-utils/compression"]
isolation = ["tauri-utils/isolation"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-utils/config-toml"]

[package]
name = "tauri-macros"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "Macros for the tauri crate."
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
quote = "1"
heck = "0.5"

[dependencies.proc-macro2]
version = "1"
features = ["span-locations"]

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.tauri-codegen]
version = "~2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-codegen"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[features]
custom-protocol = []
compression = ["tauri-codegen/compression"]
isolation = ["tauri-codegen/isolation"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-codegen/config-json5", "tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-codegen/config-toml", "tauri-utils/config-toml"]
tracing = []

[package]
name = "tauri-runtime"
version = "2.11.3"
description = "Runtime for Tauri applications"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-linux-android", "x86_64-apple-ios"]

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
http = "1"
raw-window-handle = "0.6"
cookie = "0.18"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "~2.9.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-utils"

[dependencies.url]
version = "2"

[dependencies.dpi]
version = "0.1"
features = ["serde"]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.61"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_System_WinRT"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.gtk]
version = "0.18"
features = ["v3_24"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
jni = "0.21"

[target."cfg(all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.objc2-ui-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["UIView", "UIResponder", "UIScene", "UISceneOptions"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
url = "2"
objc2 = "0.6"

[features]
devtools = []
macos-private-api = []

[package]
name = "tauri-runtime-cef"
version = "0.1.0"
links = "tauri_runtime_cef"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[[test]]
name = "macos-application-bootstrap"
harness = false

[dependencies]
base64 = "0.22"
dirs = "6"
dioxus-debug-cell = "0.1"
http = "1"
html5ever = "0.29"
log = "0.4.21"
raw-window-handle = "0.6"
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
url = "2"
winit = "=0.31.0-beta.2"

[dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.11.5"
path = "./crates/tauri"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tauri-macros]
version = "~2.6.3"
path = "./crates/tauri-macros"

[dependencies.cef]
version = "=151.8.0"
features = ["build-util", "linux-x11"]

[dependencies.cef-dll-sys]
version = "=151.8.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.kuchiki]
package = "kuchikiki"
version = "0.8.8-speedreader"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tauri-runtime]
version = "2.11.2"
path = "../tauri-runtime"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "2.9.2"
path = "../tauri-utils"
features = ["html-manipulation"]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.softbuffer]
version = "0.4"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.61"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Graphics_Dwm", "Win32_Graphics_Gdi", "Win32_System_Com", "Win32_Globalization", "Win32_System_LibraryLoader", "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse", "Win32_UI_Shell", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-application-services]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["HIServices", "Processes"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["NSApplication", "NSBezierPath", "NSColor", "NSControl", "NSDockTile", "NSEvent", "NSImage", "NSImageView", "NSProgressIndicator", "NSResponder", "NSRunningApplication", "NSScreen", "NSView", "NSWindow", "block2", "objc2-core-graphics", "objc2-quartz-core"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-quartz-core]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["CALayer", "objc2-core-graphics"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["NSArray", "NSDate", "NSLocale", "NSNotification", "NSObject", "NSValue", "NSRunLoop", "NSString", "NSThread", "NSTimer", "NSURL"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"
x11-dl = "2.21"
wayland-client = "0.31"

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.dlopen2]
version = "0.8"
features = ["derive"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.gtk]
version = "0.18"
features = ["v3_24"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.softbuffer]
version = "0.4"
default-features = false
features = ["wayland", "x11"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.wayland-backend]
version = "0.3"
features = ["client_system"]

[features]
default = []
devtools = ["tauri-runtime/devtools", "tauri/devtools"]
macos-private-api = ["tauri-runtime/macos-private-api", "tauri/macos-private-api"]
unstable = ["tauri/unstable"]

[package]
name = "tauri-utils"
version = "2.9.3"
description = "Utilities for Tauri"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
anyhow = "1"
thiserror = "2"
serde_with = "3"
json-patch = "4.0"
glob = "0.3.1"
urlpattern = "0.6"
regex = "1"
memchr = "2"
semver = "1"
infer = "0.22"
dunce = "1"
log = "0.4.21"
serde-untagged = "0.1"
http = "1"
plist = "1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.phf]
version = "0.13"
features = ["macros"]

[dependencies.brotli]
version = "8"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.url]
version = "2"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.html5ever]
version = "0.29"
optional = true

[dependencies.kuchiki]
package = "kuchikiki"
version = "0.8.8-speedreader"
optional = true

[dependencies.dom_query]
version = "0.28"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.proc-macro2]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.quote]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.schemars]
version = "1"
features = ["url2", "uuid1"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aes-gcm]
version = "0.10"
optional = true

[dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.3"
optional = true
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.serialize-to-javascript]
version = "0.1.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.ctor]
version = "1.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.json5]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.toml]
version = ">=0.9, <=1"
features = ["parse"]

[dependencies.walkdir]
version = "2"
optional = true

[dependencies.cargo_metadata]
version = "0.19"
optional = true

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["serde"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.swift-rs]
version = "1.0.8"
optional = true
features = ["build"]

[dev-dependencies]
serial_test = "3.5"
tempfile = "3.15.0"

[dev-dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.3"
features = ["std"]

[dev-dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.11.5"
path = "./crates/tauri"
default-features = false

[features]
build = ["proc-macro2", "quote", "cargo_metadata", "schema", "swift-rs", "html-manipulation"]
build-2 = ["proc-macro2", "quote", "cargo_metadata", "schema", "swift-rs", "html-manipulation-2"]
compression = ["brotli"]
schema = ["schemars"]
isolation = ["aes-gcm", "getrandom", "serialize-to-javascript"]
process-relaunch-dangerous-allow-symlink-macos = []
config-json5 = ["json5"]
config-toml = []
resources = ["walkdir"]
html-manipulation = ["dep:html5ever", "dep:kuchiki"]
html-manipulation-2 = ["dep:dom_query"]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/blockworked/cef-rs"]
git = "https://github.com/blockworked/cef-rs"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "b8fad92"

[source."https://github.com/tauri-apps/winit-gtk4"]
git = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/winit-gtk4"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "master"

[source."https://github.com/blockworked/tauri"]
git = "https://github.com/blockworked/tauri"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "a477e80d"
